description: Install a One-Click App on a dedicated server (queued, takes a few minutes; check with get_dedicated_apps). Follow the catalog entry's install guidance first. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

catalogType.description: Catalog type from the app catalog.

envValues.description: Non-secret catalog fields only (see the catalog entry's install.requiredCustomerEnvFields).

serviceId.description: ID of the Dedicated server: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_dedicated_servers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: install_dedicated_app
title: Install Dedicated Server One-Click App
